import asyncio
from collections.abc import Awaitable


async def run(groups, other, read, output):
    for batch in groups:
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(read(item)) for item in batch]
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    for batch in groups:
        report(len(batch))
        tasks: list[Awaitable[Row]] = [read(item) for item in batch if item.enabled]
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        output.extend(rows)
    for batch in groups:
        tasks: list[Awaitable[Row]] = [read(item) for item in other if item.enabled]
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        tasks = [await read(item) for item in batch]
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
